# gemv

![gemv function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/blas/15-gemv.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

y = alpha*op(A)*x + beta*y; updates the leading result block, retains the full y length and untouched tail. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: y=zero_vector_rows_op_a, alpha=1, beta=1, operation_a=0.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**gemv**

Calcule alpha·op(A)·x+beta·y, en conservant la fin de y hors calcul. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : y=zero_vector_rows_op_a, alpha=1, beta=1, operation_a=0.

</details>
